text:
alex: Originating RC rc-20241003-latewindow at artifact sha:d4d3c2b1. Small perf config: reduce kernel batch timeout on dedicated pools. Quiet window 22:45-23:45 UTC. Need quick sheriff + QA ack.

deploy-bot: [CI] rc-20241003-latewindow build passed. Unit/integration/smoke green. Release notes draft: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20241003-latewindow

mia: Is this scoped only to dedicated pools? Any flag leakage risk?

alex: Scoped to routing tag 'dedicated-optim'. snippet: `kernel.batch.timeout = { scope: "dedicated-optim" }`. No DB migrations.

sheriff: I'll cover quiet window. Need commit sha, rollback artifact, and abort thresholds. Also request a deadman timer.

alex: commit sha: d4d3c2b1. rollback artifact: sha:a1b2c3d4 (rc-stable). Abort if error rate >1.2% or p99 +40% sustained 10m. Deadman 20m. Playbook: /runbooks/rc-rollback.md

qa-runner: Running quick preflight evals: rerank and hallucination checks queued; ETA ~10m. Canary harness ready.

release-coordinator: Reminder to pin artifact on success and add ops note about kernel timeout tweak.

deploy-bot: Promotion command example:
```
/deploy promote --env=prod --rc=rc-20241003-latewindow --artifact=sha:d4d3c2b1 \
  --canary-stages=3,30,100 --quiet-window=22:45-23:45UTC --deadman=20m \
  --notify=@sheriff --notes-url=https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20241003-latewindow
```

mia: Request start at 3% for 10m, then 30% for 20m. Watch rerank_exact_match, p99, and token cost.

sheriff: Accepted. I'll monitor dashboards and escalate if thresholds crossed.

alex: initiating promotion now. @deploy-bot please promote.

deploy-bot: ACTION by alex: scheduled promotion at 22:49 UTC. Stage 1: 3% canary deploy starting... done. Health checks passing.

qa-runner: quick smoke on canary looks clean. rerank delta ~0.01% within noise.

deploy-bot: Stage 2: moving to 30% traffic. Rolling update in progress... routing updated. Health: passing.

sheriff: watching. error rate 0.3%, p99 stable.

mia: no sign of memory pressure. token cost slightly down as expected.

alex: if green for 18m we go to 100%.

deploy-bot: Stage 3: promoting to 100% traffic. Rolling update across regions; ETA ~6m.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All regions at rc-20241003-latewindow artifact sha:d4d3c2b1. Post-deploy checks OK.

qa-runner: extended evals running (30m). so far clean.

sheriff: marking rollout stable. deadman canceled.

release-coordinator: Pinning artifact to rc/latewindow/20241003 and publishing release notes. Link: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20241003-latewindow#changelog

deploy-bot: Postdeploy watch active for 30m. Automatic rollback ticket will be created if thresholds exceeded. Rollback command:
```
/deploy rollback --env=prod --to-artifact=sha:a1b2c3d4 --reason="regression EV-XXXX or manual abort"
```

mia: FYI tiny 0.2% dip in one rerank cohort; filing EV-5012 for follow-up. Not blocking.

alex: Thanks team. We'll triage EV-5012 in the next patch unless it worsens. Closing thread but keeping watch for 24h.
